Covering 26.2 miles from the suburbs into the city, the historic route of the Boston Marathon brings world-class athletes racing through eight Massachusetts cities and towns every year on Patriot's Day.The race runs through Hopkinton, Ashland, Framingham, Natick, Wellesley, Newton, Brookline and Boston.Boston Marathon coverage: How to watch | Race forecast | Find Your FinishIt begins on Main Street in Hopkinton and follows Route 135 through Ashland, Framingham, Natick and Wellesley, to where Route 135 joins Route 16. The course continues on Route 16 through Newton Lower Falls, then turns right onto Commonwealth Avenue through the Newton Hills. Next, the race bears right at the reservoir onto Chestnut Hill Avenue to Cleveland Circle. A left onto Beacon Street brings the course through Brookline, Kenmore Square and under Massachusetts Avenue. The course turns right onto Hereford Street and then left onto Boylston Street, where the finish line is in Copley Square. For athletes, fluid stations are set up along the course starting at mile 2 and three hydrogel depots are available, at mile 11.8 on the Wellesley town line, mile 17 in Newton and mile 21.5 just after Boston College. Digital clocks are positioned every 5,000 kilometers and at key mile locations. Race officials also establish 26 medical stations along the course. It happened Monday morning in the San Fernando Valley community of Pacoima, California. Video shows a low-flying plane strike a power line, triggering a small explosion, before plummeting about 30 feet to a parking lot below. According to officials with the Los Angeles Fire Department, a 70-year-old man was flying the Cessna 172.After striking the power line, the plane nosedived into an O'Reilly’s auto shop parking lot below.Local news outlets report that the plane was returning to the nearby Whiteman Airport at the time of the crash. The pilot, who was the only person in the plane, was taken to a nearby hospital for treatment. His condition is unknown.No additional injuries were reported.Officials with the Federal Aviation Administration say the crash is under investigation.
